data.title: Highest freezer temperature is always 0
story: The function highest_temp(readings) finds the highest temperature from the sensor readings. For normal rooms the result is right.
But in the freezer, where every temperature is negative, the result is always 0 °C. Fix it so it works for negative numbers too.

explanation: A starting value of highest = 0 is already bigger than every negative temperature, so it never gets replaced. Start from the first item in the list, readings[0], so negative numbers are compared correctly.
hints: Print highest inside the loop with print() for the freezer data.
Is -15 > 0? If not, when does highest ever change?
Replace the starting value 0 with readings[0].
